result.paraphrase: SkyHawk AISmart. Safe. Secure. AI surveillance applications using ImagePerfect AI firmware provide superior image integrity for random read, 24×7 workloads. Scalable AI workloads can support as many as 32 AI streams while recording up to 64 camera streams. Built for AI with a 550TB/year workload rating—more than 3× higher than standard surveillance-optimized drives. 1.5M MTBF delivers a better total cost of ownership. An optional 2-year Seagate Rescue Data Recovery Service plan is available with every SkyHawk AI drive
